text: At its meeting held on October 8 and 9, 2025, City Council appointed the following members to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund Board for a term of office from October 10, 2025, to October 11, 2029, and until successors are appointed: Jehad Aliweiwi; and Elizabeth McCallion These new appointments fill the positions previously held by Stuart Galloway and Kim Marshall whose terms of office came to an end on July 15, 2025. City Council also reappointed Jean Olemou for a term of office from October 10, 2025, to October 11, 2029, and until a successor is appointed.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund received the item for information.
